metadata.recommended_default: Default to domain-local delivery until at least two funded production use cases need the same control contracts and a positive shared-cost case is evidenced.

nodes.title: Select build, buy, embed or partner

metadata.recommended_default: Default to embedding bounded SaaS-native tasks and extending governed shared integration only where cross-system control warrants it.

nodes.title: Choose a central, federated or hybrid model

metadata.recommended_default: Default to a hybrid model with central control contracts and domain-owned use cases.
Default to pooled compute with isolated identities, context, memory, evidence and policy partitions, subject to negative tests.
Default to read-only or human-approved side effects until task-specific evidence supports greater autonomy.
Default to shared Fabric ownership of reusable controls and domain ownership of use-case outcomes and assertions.
Default to ephemeral, policy-constrained workers for execution with side effects or untrusted code.

nodes.title: Set runtime limits and scaling signals

metadata.recommended_default: Default to explicit step, wall-time, token and tool limits, with autoscaling driven by queue age and saturation.
Default to registered, version-pinned input/output schemas and explicit side-effect classifications.
Default to Gateway-enforced action authorisation with a signed, scoped receipt and idempotency key before every external mutation.
Default to ACL-aware retrieval, source-level provenance and policy rechecks before context is consumed.
Default to no durable memory write without provenance, policy classification, owner, retention and verification status.
Default to signed, policy-brokered handoff packets with bounded sharing; do not share unrestricted mutable memory.
Default to canonical IDs with source lineage and explicit unresolved-conflict states; never silently choose the newest record as truth.
Default to a single Harness owning the trajectory, checkpoint and bounded step policy, with renewed authorisation on resume.
Default to explicit approval for irreversible, financial or sensitive external mutations unless Governance has approved a narrower low-risk envelope.
Default to risk- and quality-constrained routing, with provider failover only inside preapproved data and evaluation boundaries.
Default to mandatory PEP checks on mutable external actions, enforced by credentials, routing policy and egress controls.
Default to separate authenticated identities, short-lived workload credentials and tenant-bound claims.
Default to signed, audience-bound, expiring delegation with monotonically narrowing permissions at each hop.
Default to boundary-specific, version-pinned protocol contracts with conformance and downgrade tests.
Default to task and risk-specific behavioural assertions, trajectory checks and negative tests before approval.
Default to fail-closed promotion for failed critical assertions, with signed gate evidence and an executable rollback plan.
Default to shared correlation identifiers and access-controlled evidence envelopes with explicit retention classes.
Default to classification-led location and retention rules that cover every derived store and provider boundary.
Default to tenant, use-case and trajectory-level showback based on cost per successful task, with budgets and invoice reconciliation.
Default to risk-tiered SLOs, queue-age/quality signals, tested RTO/RPO and approved degradation modes.
Default to SRE-led incident command with Security authority for containment of risk-bearing credentials, egress and tainted memory.
Default to approved archetypes, automated contract tests, named domain owners and time-limited exceptions.

nodes.title: Retire use cases and the Fabric

metadata.recommended_default: Default to a formal retirement gate proving token revocation, data disposition, preserved obligations and tested export or migration.
